content: Yesu ꞌina yatala Pailato matana
Gona ꞌiꞌadaleya, topwaoli madoudi ma babada mabwaiyadi siloina Yesu weyahina, nuwanuwadi ꞌabehega siloheꞌamasi.
Coinega Yesu nimana sipaidiya ma sitauyeya toloina madouna Pailato ꞌoina, ma ꞌabehega Pailatoina ꞌida loina.
Yudasa ꞌina ꞌamasa
Ma Yudasaina ꞌisanapuya ꞌabehega Yesu ꞌiꞌiuna ma siloheꞌamasi, ꞌoinega ꞌinuwabuiya, ta ꞌina mane siliba teti ꞌihilediya topwaoliyao ma babadao ꞌoidiya,
ta ꞌigwae, “Yalopuiya, weyahina loheya bwebweꞌana ꞌoimiya yatebaeya.” Ma sigwaeya, “Beno geya ꞌaigeda toꞌaha ꞌoima, ma ꞌowa tuwa weyahiu ꞌunuwanuwatuhu.”
Coinega mane tetiyedi ꞌiula suluhedi Hada Heꞌasisi ꞌalona, ma ꞌihapwesa ma ꞌitauya, ma balaeyega ꞌaniꞌona ꞌididi heyapasiya, ta ꞌiꞌamasa.
Ma topwaoliyedi maneyedi sihegogonediya, ta sigwae, “Geya sawasawahina ma Yehoba ꞌana helau ꞌoina talagulagu, weyahina mane bewa loheya ꞌana loheꞌamasa maisana.”
Coinega siboidimo siloina ma maneina ꞌoinega ꞌaigeda toꞌabi walata ꞌina baleꞌu ꞌaigeda sihemaiseya, ma ꞌabehega baleꞌuina taumanao ꞌadi galiha.
Coinega baleꞌuina sibwauweya, “Bweyaha baleꞌuina”, ma saninaina ꞌabwa ꞌimiyamiya.
Nage ꞌoina toꞌaha palopita Yelemaiya ꞌigwae nugeteya ꞌihapwesa, weyahina mwalo Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌoina sileleya ꞌabehega,

content.text: “MeIsileli tauna ꞌana maisa sibwauweya, beno dimwa siliba ꞌadi baibaiwa teti, ta maneyedi siꞌewedima.
Ma ꞌoinega toꞌabi walataina ꞌina baleꞌu sihemaiseya, gidemusa ꞌida Bada ꞌihemataluwegauwa.”

content: Pailato Yesu ꞌihesilaleya
Coinega Yesu Pailato matana sihetoholoya, tauna toloina madouna, ma Pailatoina Yesu ꞌihesilaleya, ꞌigwae, “Cuhepwaila, ꞌowa meYudiya ꞌidi kini, ꞌawa?” Ma Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Beno ꞌugwae pwaiya.”
Coinega topwaoli madoudi ma babadao Yesu siheꞌeweya Pailato matana, ma Yesu geya ꞌaigeda toꞌaha ꞌihehemaise.
Ma Pailato ꞌigwaeya, “Togidega, hepwaila bewa ꞌa heꞌewa weyahidi ꞌuhesagoheya?”
Ma Yesu geya wete ꞌihemaise, ma tuwa ꞌihehenono, ꞌoinega Pailatoina nuwana ꞌihepwanopwanowa madouna.
Pailato ꞌiloina ma Yesu siloheꞌamasi
Bolime ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda ꞌoidiya, Hataona Guyaina ꞌoina toloinaina ꞌina mumuga beno deliyega ꞌaigeda loheya ꞌilihasi ma ꞌilatu, ꞌeguma taiya boda sihesinuweya.
Ma tuta nage ꞌoina ꞌaigeda loheya deliya ꞌimiyamiya, sanina Balaba, tomota mabwaiyadi sisanapuya ꞌabehega tauna togala madouna.
Coinega tomota mabwaiyadi siꞌetoꞌautama Pailato ꞌoina, ma Pailato ꞌihesilalediya, ꞌihegwaediya, “To loheya nuwanuwami ma weyahimi yalihasi? Balaba? bo Yesu tauna sibwauweya Toꞌabihetena?”
Weyahina Pailato ꞌisanapuya ꞌabehega heꞌipiꞌipiyega Yesu sitebaeya sabi loheꞌamasina.

Ma wete tutaina ꞌabwa Pailato yatala ꞌipaipaihowa, ma mwanena wasa ꞌihetuneyama ma ꞌigwaeya, “Sahena wete toꞌaha ꞌuloinae loheya beno bwebweꞌana. Weyahina nige yanihiyeya, ta ꞌebe matauta madouna ꞌoiguwa.”
Ma hesi topwaoli madoudi ta babadao tomota siboꞌa heyaheyabadi ma ꞌabehega siꞌahwanoi Pailato ꞌoina ma Balaba ꞌilihasi ꞌoidiya ta Yesu siloheꞌamasi.
Coinega toloinaina ꞌihesilalediya, ꞌigwaeya, “Siteluwa ꞌoidiyega taiya nuwanuwami ma weyahimi yalihasi.” Coinega sigwaeya, “Balaba.”
Ma Pailato ꞌigwaeya, “Ma togidega yaloina ꞌese Yesu tauna sibwauweya Toꞌabihetena?” Coinega mabwaiyadi sigwaeya, “Kelose ꞌoina tada tutuhepaꞌine!”
Ma Pailato ꞌihegwaediya, “Toꞌaha hede ꞌina pui, ma ꞌoinega ꞌabehega ꞌamasa ꞌiloba?” Ma sibwau ꞌasoꞌasona, sigwaeya, “Kelose ꞌoina tada tutuhepaꞌine!”

Coinega Pailato ꞌisanapuya ꞌabehega geya ꞌina waiwaimo, ma boda siheꞌoheꞌohe ꞌana ꞌoleya ꞌabehega nata sihegaina ma siheꞌupwa. Coinega weꞌahega nimana ꞌibuyoya bodaedi matadiya, ma ꞌigwae, “Sahena wete toꞌaha yaloiloina loheya bewa bwebweꞌana ꞌina ꞌamasa weyahina, ma waboimo wada loina.”
Ma boda mabwaiyadi sigwaeya, “Bwebweꞌana! Tauma ꞌada loina, ma ꞌana maisa ꞌada loba, tauma, ma mehau sihanehanema ꞌoidiya wete.”
Coinega Pailato ꞌidi gwae ꞌihesagoheya, ta Balaba ꞌilihasiya, ma wete ꞌina toloꞌalehao ꞌiloinaediya ma Yesu balaeyega sisapi, ma muliyetega ꞌabwa situtuhepaꞌi kelose ꞌoina.
Toloꞌalehao Yesu siloꞌaleheya
Coinega toloinaina ꞌina toloꞌalehao Yesu sisapiya, ma siluhuweya ꞌidi hada madouna ꞌalona, ta ꞌidi boda mabwaiyadi sibwau heꞌautedima Yesu ꞌoina,
ma ꞌana ꞌaleꞌowao sihalolodiya, ta ꞌaleꞌo wasawasa ꞌoinega siheꞌoteya sabi lotuyae,
ma ꞌana talatala talitali ꞌoidiyega sipaihoweya, ma debana silaguya, ma guna ꞌina ꞌebeula silaguya, ma wete matana siꞌetuluha ma silolotuyane, sigwaeya, “Yauwedo ꞌowa meYudiya ꞌidi kini, ꞌawa?”
Ma wete siꞌesoheya, ta ꞌina guna siꞌeweya, ma ꞌoinega debana sisapiya.
Ta ꞌidi lotuyana ꞌigumwala, ma ꞌaleꞌo wasawasa ꞌoinega sihaloloya, ta tauna ꞌana ꞌaleꞌowega siheꞌwama hileya, ma sitoeya sabi hekeloseye.
Yesu situtu hepaꞌineya kelose ꞌoina
Yesu sihapweseya ma sitauyeya, ma ꞌedai Sailini loheyaina ꞌaigeda, sanina Saimoni, sihalobeya, ma siloineya ma Yesu ꞌana kelose ꞌiꞌahali.
Ma Saimoniina ꞌiꞌahala ta ꞌana siga silatuwa Goligota tupwaina. (Goligota, ꞌana sanapu beno mwagu ꞌasaina.)
Ta waini ma paseꞌuma sihebweliyeya ta siꞌebwaeya, ma ꞌabehega sahena muya madouna ꞌilotolotoho, ma hesi Yesu ꞌilotohoyamowa ta ꞌilogwahateya.

Coinega, kelose baleꞌuwa silaguya ma Yesu ꞌoina situtu hepaꞌiya ma sihetoholoya, ma muliyetega topaihowaedi Yesu ꞌana ꞌaleꞌo siꞌewediya ma siguyaiyeya siboimo ꞌoidiya, ma ꞌidi heguyai ꞌeꞌopiꞌopi sipaihoweya gide kati, ma ꞌeguma taiya ꞌinugeta ꞌana ꞌaleꞌo ꞌida ꞌewa.
Muliyetega simiyatoiya ma siheheꞌasine.
Ma wete ꞌana kelose tabwanina sileleya, “Yesu tauna meYudiya ꞌadi toloina.” Beno ꞌina ꞌamasaina lamuna.
Wete toyagaha ꞌeluwa siꞌabi hekelosediya, ꞌaigeda Yesu ꞌina ꞌebeulega ma ꞌaigeda ꞌina ꞌadigeyegeyega.
Ma tomota tupwadi ꞌedai Yesu ꞌana kelose ꞌoina silolotuyana ma sihehenama,
sigwae “Ca mudala! Cugwaeya ꞌabehega sawasawahiu ma Hada Heꞌasisi ꞌuligehi ma sabwelo ꞌetoi ꞌoina ꞌuꞌabihila. Hana ꞌuda ꞌetopelego ꞌuboi ma keloseyega ꞌusuluma, ꞌeguma ꞌowa Yehoba Natuna.”
Wete gidemusa topwaoli madoudi ta loina ꞌana toheꞌitao ta babada Yesu silotuyaneya, ma sigwae,
“Hali tomota ꞌilemediya, ma tauna ꞌida ꞌetopele. Tauna ꞌabehega tupwa Isileli ꞌana toloina. Hana keloseyega ꞌisuluma ma ꞌoinega tahemisae.
Tauna ꞌabehega Yehoba ꞌana tohemisa ma ꞌigwaeya, ‘Taugu Yehoba Natuna.’ Ceguma Yehoba nuwanuwana tauna, ꞌida ꞌetolihasi, ꞌawa?”
Ma toyagahaedi Yesu baꞌidanao siꞌabi hekelosediya, taudi ꞌadi keloseyega sibwaꞌabala ma taudi Yesu siheliyeya.
Yesu ꞌina ꞌamasa
Casudiladila ma lahilahi gogo mabwaiyana ꞌiguguyouwa.
Ma lahilahiya Yesu ꞌenana madounega ꞌibwauwa ma ꞌigwaeya, “Eli, eli, lamasabakitani!” Cana bui beno gide, “Cigu Yehoba, ꞌigu Yehoba, toꞌaha weyahina ꞌuꞌebesinegauwa?”
Ma tupwana tomota deina sitotoholo ꞌina bwau sihesagoheya, ma sigwaeya, “Wahesagohe! Loheya bewa Ilaitiya ꞌibwaubwauwe.”
Coinega ꞌaigeda ꞌoidiyega ꞌipiliya ma balou ꞌiꞌeweya, ma waini memaina ꞌoina ꞌihepwaseya, ꞌoinega ꞌaigeda ꞌaiꞌaiwe matana ꞌibadiyeya, ma ꞌiheꞌetohaneheya Yesu ꞌahwana, ma ꞌimalaꞌuꞌuya.
Ma loheyaina ꞌiyanao sigwaeya, “Tuwa tayamwayamwa, nuwana nata Ilaitiya ꞌilatuma ma ꞌiꞌetolihasi.”
Ma Yesu ꞌenana madounega ꞌibwau hila, ma yawasina ꞌigumwala.
Ma ꞌaleꞌoina* Hada Heꞌasisi ꞌana libu ꞌilotaliliya tabwanega ma ꞌisuluwa duduna, ma mwaniꞌiniꞌi ꞌipiliya, ma daꞌule madoudi siꞌemutumutudiya.
Ma wete galiha siꞌesoꞌediya ma tohemisao tupwana baibaiwadi mwalo siꞌamasa wahidi sitoholo hila,
ma Yesu ꞌina toholo mulina taudi wete galihega sihapwesama, ma Yelusalema ꞌoina siluhuwa, ma tomota tupwana baibaiwadi ꞌoidiya sihapwesa.
Ma toloꞌalehaowedi maꞌidi tohanugeta saugenina Yesu kelose ꞌoina siꞌitaꞌitayahiya, mwaniꞌiniꞌi ma ginaula mabwaiyana siꞌitediya, ta simatauta madouna, sigwaeya, “Moisa, loheya bewa Yehoba Natuna.”
Yesu ꞌana lagu taona
Wahiwahine wete tupwana bwagebwagega siꞌeꞌebubuna, taudi mwalo Galiliyega Yesu sihemuli tabubuweyama, ma ꞌana sipaipaihowa.
Caigeda sanina Meli Magidala, ma ꞌina waliyesa tauna Yemesa ma Yosepa sinadiu, ma wete Sebedi natunao sinadiu.
Lahilahiya ꞌaigeda Alimatiya loheyaina ꞌinaoma Pailato ꞌoina, tauna towasawasa ma wete Yesu ꞌana tomuliya ꞌaigeda, sanina Yosepa.
Ma Pailato ꞌoina wahina ꞌiꞌahwanoiyeya, ma Pailato ꞌitagwala.
Citagwala, ma Yosepa maꞌina hewahewaliyao Yesu wahina siꞌeweya, ma ꞌaleꞌo waꞌewaꞌeꞌena ma ꞌehauna ꞌoinega siwaduhiya.
Ma Yosepaina ꞌana galiha hauhauna ꞌoina silaguya, ma galihina sipidiya gide duluha ꞌalona. Ma daꞌule madouna ma pwaꞌupwaꞌuwana ꞌoinega galihina ꞌahwana silagu bodeya, ma muliyetega Yosepa ꞌitauya.
Ma Meli Magidala maꞌina waliyesa galihina deina simiyatoiya, ma siheheꞌasine.
Galiha siꞌitayahiya
Ma Yesu siꞌabi hekeloseyeya meYudiya ꞌidi sabwelo ꞌatububu ꞌoina, ꞌoinega gona ꞌiꞌadaleya, beno ꞌidi Sabati, topwaoli madouna ma Palisiyao bodaidi sitauya Pailato ꞌoina,
ma sigwaeya, “Bada, toꞌaboina mwalo mayawasina ꞌimiyamiya ꞌina gwae ꞌanuwatuhuya ꞌigwae, ‘Sabwelo ꞌetoi ma ꞌamasega yatoholo hila.’

Coinega ꞌeguma sawasawahina, ꞌuloina ma galiha ꞌana toꞌitayahinao siꞌitayahi bwaibwaini ma ꞌana siga sabwelo ꞌetoi, tabu ta ꞌana tomuliyao sinaoma ma Yesu wahina siyagahi ma sidene, ma tomota siꞌabowedi ꞌabehega ꞌamasega ꞌitoholo hila, ma ꞌoinega ꞌabo mulimuliyana ꞌabo nugetana ꞌida gala sine.”
Ma Pailato ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwaeya, “Cimi toꞌita yahinaowedi toloꞌalehao simiyamiya, watauyedi ma galiha simiya loyamwa bwaibwaini.”
Coinega sitauya ma galiha ꞌahwana ꞌana loboda dimwaina wete sibwadeya, ma nobwa toꞌitayahinaedi sihalagudiya.
